children.code:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

function conversionRate(
    int $conversions,
    int $visitors
): float {
    return $visitors > 0
        ? ($conversions / $visitors) * 100.0
        : 0.0;
}

echo conversionRate(750, 25000); // 3
